brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Russian and German foreign ministers met for the first time since the Ukraine invasion. [1]
Military Medical Services visited Germany’s Ottobock to strengthen cooperation in rehabilitation and prosthetic services. [2]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR GERMANY
The meeting between Russian and German foreign ministers occurs while Germany has a Country Instability Index score of 36 of 100, in the Normal band. [1][E1]
Germany's 67% net energy import dependency underscores the significance of diplomatic engagement with Russia. [1][E4]

KEY RISKS
Germany's net energy import dependency of 67% exposes it to potential supply disruptions. [E4]
Germany is linked to 130 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, which could affect international relations. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market asks if Friedrich Merz is out as Chancellor of Germany before December 31, 2026, priced Yes at 11% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2027. [E6]
A Kalshi market asks who the next German federal election winner is, with AfD priced at 83% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Mar 25, 2030. [E8]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the meeting between Russian and German foreign ministers remains to be seen. [1]
Whether the AfD's extremism deters other far-right parties from cooperation is an unresolved dynamic. [5]
